steps.title: Exam conditions mean exam conditions
steps.body:
Order: CO 35 min → CE 60 min → EE 60 min → EO 12 min. One sitting, desk, phone off, no pausing audio, no dictionary.
EO: record yourself; mark it with the tutor or the rubric.

steps.title: The overriding rule
steps.body:
**Do not sit the exam until a full mock clears all four thresholds with margin.** One attempt at ₦750k.
And with re-marking suspended, there is no appeal behind it.

steps.q: Mock C: CO 470, CE 465, EE 10/20, EO 12/20. Decision?
options: Borderline — EE has no margin; repair writing in week 20 and re-test tâche 2
GO — everything is at or above threshold
steps.explain: 10/20 is exactly the threshold with zero margin. The rule says *with margin*.

points: GO only with margin on all four
